description: This PHP class `ReviewerRatingModel` represents a data model for reviewer ratings within the OrangeHRM performance management module. It uses traits and interfaces to facilitate serialization and normalization of reviewer rating entities, including properties like id, rating, comment, and associated KPI id.

classes.name: ReviewerRatingModel
classes.description: A data model for normalizable reviewer rating entities, including serialization configurations based on an underlying ReviewerRating entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ReviewerRatingModel with a ReviewerRating entity and sets serialization filters and attribute mappings.
